text:
Maria: Hey team — PR https://git.redwood/infra/pr/9123 is blocked on architecture eyes. I linked the RFC but want an explicit arch ack before I merge into main. Can someone take a quick look? RFC: https://docs.redwood.org/rfcs/489-kv-routing

Josh: pinging @Tomas and @Olivia for arch review. This change adds a routing shim + a small cache op; should be low-risk but would like an SLO/rollback confirmation.

archbot: Assigned reviewers: @Tomas, @Olivia. Please respond within the 8 business-hour SLA for arch reviews.

Tomas: I can take a first pass. Can you paste a 2-3 line summary of the failure modes and fallback behavior here? Also we need a short SLO-delta note (latency p50/p95 impact).

Maria: TL;DR: adds route selector that prefers warm-kv cache for short prompts; fallback to cold path if cache miss or stale. Failure modes: increased p95 on cold miss bursts, possible transient duplicate writes to metrics if routing toggles. Fallback: automatic routing flag fallback to cold-path model variant. I'll add a short SLO table to the PR.

Olivia: Can you also include canary plan? I recommend 1% traffic for 1 hour -> 10% for 2 hours -> full (subject to SLO). If we can't get logs routed to the canary pipeline, I won't approve.

Josh: Agree with Olivia. Also FYI we have a release window at 2026-03-18 14:00 PST — if you want the merge in that slot we need arch ack before EOD.

Tomas: If you add the SLO delta + automatic rollback criteria (what triggers fallback), I can give LGTM today. Checklist I need in the PR: [SLO delta], [Fallback model ID], [Canary plan], [Test matrix].

Maria: On it — I'll update the PR with the SLO table and a short rollback snippet. Example rollback snippet in the PR: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood/release-toggle -d '{"route":"kv-routing","state":"off"}'`

sre-oncall: Quick note — make sure canary logs include `route=canary-kv` tag; otherwise our dashboards won't pick them up. If you need, I can add the logfilter rule once the PR is merged to staging.

Olivia: +1 to the checklist. Also, please include a short perf test run (10k small prompts) and paste the key numbers in the PR comments.

Maria: Thanks — I'll add perf numbers, SLO table, and the canary log tag. @Tomas please ping me here when you can review so I can schedule the merge.

Tomas: Will review after lunch and ping here. If everything looks good I'll leave an arch LGTM. :thumbsup:

Maria: Great — appreciate it, thanks everyone!
